description: Easy way for everyone in your company to ask questions and learn from data.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created on delete-data. Evidence: docs/evidence/metabase-qualification.json. Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine and one architecture only.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Asks you to create an administrator account the first time you open it, and can then connect to databases you give it credentials for.
